feature: pre-allocation sustained B2 short-Q1 context bound
license: mlx2 original project code; no upstream code copied
modifications: A 32-token sustained B2 prompt is admitted only through length 97, since its 31 later one-token ready steps reach at most 128 visible KV tokens. Length 98 would reach 129 and leave the mandatory short-Q1 tile path. Two-token v2/v3 profiles retain their previous 32–127 bound. The profile validator rejects overlong sustained cohorts before shared native arena allocation.
validation: CPU boundary checks admit 97, reject 98, and prove shared-arena factory is not called for a rejected cohort. Native GPU work is not needed for this admission-only change.
